messages:
Maya (support): Heads-up: ACME reports tool-call failures after last model rollout. They see a schema validation error when invoking the price lookup tool, and their integration CI (golden prompts) started failing too.  
Devon (ml-eng): Any error snippet from them? is it validation or the tool returning non-json?
Rita (customer): """Error: ToolResponseSchemaMismatch: expected {"price":number} got {"price_cents":12345}.
stack: /v1/invoke -> tool-selector -> price_lookup -> validate_response"""
Maya (support): They say the selector picked "price_lookup_v2" after the rollout. That variant returns cents instead of dollars. Failing fast in their CI.
Sam (eng-infra): Noted. Could be model variant mapping changed. @Devon can you check the model->tool mapping rules & any recent selector policy changes? :eyes:
Devon (ml-eng): Looking. I pushed a variant that standardizes price field but forgot to add the compatibility shim. Reproducer from their CI: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"Get price for sku:123", "tools": ["price_lookup"]}'
```
CI Bot: failed tests: tests/evals/golden/price_tool/golden-001.json -> expected dollars, got cents (delta: 100x)
Rita (customer): Their nightly CI is blocking deploys. They want rollback or workaround.
Maya (support): Customer asked if we can force the old variant for their org (org_id: acme-42) until fix ships. Can we add temporary routing?
Sam (eng-infra): We can add a per-org routing rule in the gateway for short-term. Requires a config change + 30s restart of route agent. Approve?
Devon (ml-eng): I'll prepare a compatibility patch: transformer will accept price_cents and normalize to price (float dollars) but we should also add a schema compatibility test to the golden-suite to catch this next time.
Maya (support): Plan: 1) add per-org routing rule for acme-42 -> pin to price_lookup_v1 2) patch runtime to normalize cents->dollars 3) add golden prompt in CI and a unit test for schema shape 4) notify customer ETA 2 hours. Sound good?
Rita (customer): Pin is enough for now, thanks. Please share ETA and rollback link.
Sam (eng-infra): I'll open infra task: INF-2107, will deploy routing change in staging, then prod. ETA 45m.
Devon (ml-eng): Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/412 - adds normalization and test. Local repro steps included in PR description.
Maya (support): Filing escalation ticket to eng-ml + eng-infra, tagging oncall. @Sam please post rollback config when live so I can share with ACME. :thumbsup:
CI Bot: Added test: tests/evals/golden/price_tool/cents-compat.json -> currently failing on main, will block merge until green.
Devon (ml-eng): Quick note for triage: root cause was a selector alias mapping change where v2 was introduced as a drop-in but changed units. We'll add a selector contract test to our CI (mock tool returns) so selector changes must pass schema checks.
Maya (support): Thanks everyone. I'll DM Rita with the routing link and follow up when infra confirms.
Rita (customer): Appreciate the quick action.
Sam (eng-infra): Routing change applied to prod for org acme-42: https://internal.redwood/infra/routes/INF-2107 - revertable flag set. Monitoring for 15m.
Maya (support): Confirmed ACME CI went green after pin. Closing loop after Devon's patch merges. :white_check_mark:
